description: This file defines the ICapture interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including a nested IStore interface for capturing image data. It declares methods for obtaining the interface name, capturing using a store object, and retrieving an instance of ICapture.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen images, providing methods to get the interface name, perform a capture with a store, and retrieve an instance.

classes.name: ICapture::IStore
classes.description: A nested interface within ICapture that defines a method for storing or processing image buffer data.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture device or interface.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs screen capture and stores the result using the provided IStore instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of ICapture.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
